jobs.title: Sr. Bioinformatics Scientist, MRD
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Bioinformatics Scientist will serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert within the Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) program, working collaboratively with senior scientists and leaders on complex Research and Development projects. In this role, you will participate in or lead the planning of projects and analyses, and often act as the bioinformatics lead responsible for successful project execution. You will independently determine methods and procedures for new assignments, make detailed observations, analyze data, interpret results, and provide insights that shape the next steps and direction of the project. Your work will center on developing novel methods to identify and integrate genomic and epigenetic biomarkers that improve the sensitivity and specificity of MRD assays, contributing end-to-end across the data science workflow: collecting public datasets, curating internal data, forming hypotheses, building and validating models, and exploring machine learning and AI-based approaches. You will also research new technologies, contribute ideas and concepts to improve or develop processes, and help establish methods and workflows that advance product development toward diagnostic assay products.

**Essential Duties**

Include, but are not limited to, the following:

* **Technical leadership:** Serve as bioinformatics lead and subject matter expert on one or more complex R&D projects, including those supporting diagnostic assay product development, and lead or participate in project and analysis planning.
* **Analysis and interpretation:** Independently analyze experimental data across several product or technology areas, interpret results, identify trends, problems, and discrepancies, and recommend next steps and project direction.
* **Complex problem solving:** Tackle problems of extremely complex scope where intangible variables must be evaluated, applying independent judgment to define methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria.
* **Method and study design:** Independently develop methods, procedures, and development plans for new studies, and give technical input on project planning and experimental design.
* **Data and computational management:** Manage bench-generated data and bioinformatics outputs in HPC or cloud computing environments, selecting and applying the right methods and technologies.
* **Data quality:** Evaluate the impact of nonconforming data on products or processes and address trends in study data.
* **Innovation and IP:** Track industry and technology developments, propose new techniques, lead process improvements, and contribute to the intellectual property portfolio.
* **Communication and presentation:** Present and defend scientific findings at data, group, project, and departmental meetings, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, including functional managers and the clinical lab.
* **Documentation and compliance:** Prepare and approve technical procedures, protocols, and reports, support abstracts, conferences, and publications, and follow legal, ISO, QSR, and Quality Management System requirements.
* **Mentorship and collaboration:** Train and mentor research associates and junior scientists, foster a trusting, collaborative team environment, and manage multiple projects with shifting priorities.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
* Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
* Ability to travel 5% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field; or Master’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 4 years of experience in lieu of a Ph.D.; or Bachelor’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 6 years of experience in lieu of Ph.D.
* 5+ years of industry or academia experience in bioinformatics.
* 3+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
* Extensive experience in Linux-based HPC or cloud computing environments and associated tools.
* Ability to write custom code in at least three programming or scripting languages.
* Technical expert in the area of molecular biology and/or biochemistry and/or next-generation sequencing (NGS) and genomics.
* Knowledge of product/assay research, design, or development.
* Working knowledge of statistical and mathematical methods in biology/genetics
* Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.
* Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
* Previous experience as a project lead for a team of scientists.
* 1+ years of direct people leadership and management experience.
* Previous industry experience in product development or technical support.
* Background containing a substantial amount of bioinformatics work including troubleshooting.
* Previous experience working in a molecular diagnostics/clinical laboratory setting.

The base pay for this position is $90,000.00 – $180,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

***Cross-functional Collaboration***

* Translate scientific business problems into technical AI solutions.

* Build predictive and descriptive models supporting process development and manufacturing.
* Develop statistical tools for identifying relationships between process parameters and manufacturing outcomes.
Design dashboards and decision-support systems.

* Masters' Degree and 4+ years experience; OR

High School Degree and 10+year experience

**Job ID** REQ20182695 **Category** Laboratory

  

The USC Roski Eye Institute, Department of Ophthalmology is seeking a Research Lab Technician I to join its team.

  
  

Working directly under the supervision of Dr. Benjamin Xu, the **Research Lab Technician I** provides day-to-day operational support for data management activities across all sites of a large, multicenter randomized controlled trial in ophthalmology. The Research Lab Technician I performs accurate and timely entry of clinical, imaging, and patient-reported outcome data into a cloud-based data platform and conducts initial completeness checks to identify and flag missing or inconsistent entries for follow-up. The Research Lab Technician I also performs basic data analysis and statistical testing to ensure the quality and consistency of the data.

The successful candidate will be motivated, pro-active, resourceful, and detail-oriented. The position requires excellent organizational and communication skills with the ability to be decisive and adaptable. Candidates should have experience with data entry, record keeping, and following detailed written and oral instructions.

This position is critical to ensuring that high-volume, multi-site study data are accurately captured and processed according to protocol timelines.

**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**

  

* Performs accurate and timely entry of clinical, imaging, and patient-reported outcome data into the cloud-based data platform.

* Conducts initial completeness checks to identify and flag missing or inconsistent entries for follow-up.

* Assists in the de-identification of study data and the preparation of aggregate data summaries for interim analyses and reporting.

* Supports the preparation of study forms, data dictionaries, and case report forms for repository deposit.

* Maintains orderly and secure data filing systems in compliance with institutional and NIH requirements.

* Maintains accurate records of procedures, and performs limited routine analysis and basic interpretations under close supervision.

* Maintains the work environment in orderly, operable condition, and stocks and maintains supplies as needed.

* Perform basic data analysis and statistical testing.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent (combined experience and education may substitute for the minimum education).

* Less than 1 year of related work experience.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, oral and written.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Associate’s degree and/or specialized or technical training.

* Familiarity with laboratory or clinical research procedures and equipment.

* Experience with data entry, research databases, or electronic data capture systems.

* Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal.

* Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality.

* Ability to multi-task effectively and demonstrate strong organizational skills.

* A cooperative and team-oriented attitude.

* Experience with computer programming (e.g. R, Python, Matlab) and/or biostatistical analysis is preferred.

  
  

Follows established USC and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace Code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.

  
  

This position is hybrid on-site and employee must report to work at the USC Health Science Campus in Los Angeles, CA when scheduled. Work hours and on-site days may be subject to change depending on business needs.

  
  

The hourly rate range for this position is **$21.07 - $27.00**. Today, management companies and property managers trust our outstanding customer service and quick installation every time they need new flooring installed. Impact Property Solutions has built our business around superior customer service, quality workmanship, and same-day or next-day response time. This means we provide the right flooring, at the right time.

**Come be a part of our amazing team of professionals, and build a career in a fast paced, rewarding industry!**

Impact Property Solutions is currently seeking an experienced Quality Control Technician. This position will oversee daily flooring activities and examine products, materials and overall workmanship for defects or deviations from approved project. The Quality Control Technician is required to support warehouse activities to support daily product installation. Also review project workmanship daily and document in specific detail all work activities. All work is required to be performed in a safe and professional manner.

**Duties/Responsibilities of Quality Control Technician**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

* Execute specific inspections on flooring construction and installation activities on site.
* Develop, apply, and maintain quality requirements and standards for flooring and other construction projects.
* Design and implement methods for Quality Control and process improvements for testing and inspection.
* Promote and execute quality standards, inspection processes, test methods, quality plans, documents, and reports.
* Address customer concerns and issues, escalating them as necessary for job completion and customer satisfaction
* Respond to builder and/or post-sale customer concerns regarding warranty issues, repairs, and material or quality issues
* Communicates with installers to ensure clear understanding of job specifications and installation requirements to maintain high quality job standards
* Work with account representatives in various departments to insure that complete and proper information is provided for work assignments

**Competencies of Quality Control Technician**

* Foundational flooring construction, installation, and product knowledge
* Demonstrated ability to communicate, present data, and influence decision making
* Ability to focus on details while managing multiple projects
* Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Positive attitude, self-motivation, drive, and determination
* Bilingual in Spanish preferred

Requirements:

**Requirements of Quality Control Technician**

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required
* Valid Driver’s license required
* Flooring installation or related experience
* Experience working with multifamily property management companies preferred

**Benefits**

* Competitive Health Insurance Plans
* Vision and Dental Plan
* Company paid life insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off Program
* 401(K) / Roth plan with employer match
* Generous PTO plus paid Holidays

**Physical Demands**

* The warehouse facility is not climate controlled and may experience extreme temperatures.
* Requires up to 8 hours of standing/walking (with breaks).
* Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds at times.
* Must be able to navigate warehouse and reach items both high and low
* Must be able to travel and be in a vehicle for extended periods of time.
